# The New India Assurance Co. Ltd.

> > Official insurance portal for The New India Assurance Co. Ltd., providing customer and intermediary access to policy services, KYC compliance, and policy verification.

The New India Assurance Co. Ltd. (NIA) is a government-owned general insurance company regulated by IRDAI (Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India). This portal serves as the digital gateway for policyholders, intermediaries, and agents to manage insurance policies, complete KYC requirements, and access policy-related services.

## Key Topics

- The New India Assurance Co. Ltd.
- IRDAI (Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India)
- NIA
- Insurance portal
- Customer login
- Intermediary login
- KYC compliance
- Policy verification
- General insurance
- Policy management
- Agent services
- Policyholder services

## Portal Access & Services

- [The New India Assurance Co. Ltd.](https://web.newindia.co.in/NIABancsPortal/index.html): NIA insurance portal homepage with customer/intermediary login and KYC
